name: Ripmap Encoding
definition: A technique to featurize the projected anisotropic 2D areas on the faces of a Platonic solid by using a feature grid pre-filtered with anisotropic kernels, enabling precise and efficient anisotropic area-sampling.
summary: Ripmap Encoding is a featurization method for anisotropic area-sampling in neural rendering that uses anisotropic kernels to prevent blurriness and ambiguities inherent in isotropic methods.
